name: Peach Plum Pear Photo
brandNarrative:
Inna is a documentary wedding photographer based in Philadelphia, and the founder of Peach Plum Pear Photo. With a background in photojournalism and over a decade of experience, she’s drawn to weddings for their realness: unscripted moments, genuine emotion, and meaningful connection.Her approach is laid-back and unobtrusive, creating space for couples to be themselves while she quietly documents the moments that matter most.

While studying Photojournalism at Temple University, Inna fell in love with visual storytelling and the quiet power of documentary photography.She founded Peach Plum Pear Photo in 2012, drawn to weddings for the same reason she was drawn to photojournalism: real people, real emotion, unfolding in real time.

Since then, Inna has photographed more than 400 couples and witnessed celebrations of every shape and size—

from intimate backyard elopements for two to vibrant, multicultural, weekend-long weddings with 250+ guests. What connects them all is the meaning behind the moments. Inna’s approach is documentary, laid-back, and unobtrusive. She creates space for people to be themselves, helping couples feel comfortable so genuine connections can shine through. With over a decade of experience observing human interaction and an eye for small, telling details, she anticipates moments as they happen and translates them into intimate, emotional photographs.

Her goal is simple: for you to relive one of the happiest days of your life every time you look at your

reviews.text: For my husband and I, photographer was one of the most important choices we made for our wedding. I had seen Peach Plum Pear's work in Philly Mag and fell in love with the quality and style of their work, as well as their commitment to inclusivity. Inna and her team are the best of the best. She went above and beyond the traditional role of photographer, helping us to map out our day and coordinated with our vendors to make sure everything went smoothly day of. From engagement photos to our wedding day, Inna felt like a friend. I like that our photos are the perfect mix of candid and curated. She captured beautiful moments that tell the story of our wedding day. I'm glad we get to look back at these for years to come and hope to use Peach Plum Pear for future family milestones. She also has EXCELLENT vendor recommendations and we got most of the rest of our vendor recs through her. If you're looking for the coolest and most talented photographer, look no further.
reviews.author: Michele Ozer

reviews.text: Inna, Jeanne, and their team are incredible! Inna did our engagement photos and our wedding ceremony + reception with Jeanne. Each step of the way she was incredibly kind, helpful, and communicative – and the final results were amazing! We love all of their photos; they captured so many different moments of the day and so many different people. We'll love looking at these photos for many years! Can't recommend Peach Plum Pear Photo highly enough!
reviews.author: Will Simons

reviews.text:
We were looking for a documentary style photographer to capture our day and once I came across Inna's work, I knew I didn't need to look any further. Her photos were evocative and joyful and edited just right. In a sea of light and airy wedding photographers, Inna's photos had color and depth and authenticity. I was obsessed and we very quickly booked her for our day.

Our package included an engagement shoot, which I was nervous about but so happy we did. Inna came to our home and walked around our neighborhood with us. She prompted us gently to get us comfortable and the photos came out amazing. I will forever cherish this time capsule of our lives. It was also good practice being in front of the camera and working with Inna. We knew we would enjoy having her around on our wedding day AND that she would capture the special small moments perfectly.

On our wedding day, Inna was prompt and efficient when we needed her to be (getting ready photos, our first look, family portraits), and faded into the background when that was most appropriate (ceremony, cocktail hour, reception). She also made a point to find us for special moments or when she had a cool photo idea, but never took us away from celebrating and enjoying our day. Everything felt magical as it was happening, and I feel it all again when I look at the pictures. We were especially excited to see so many parts of the night that we weren't present for, whether that was who was hanging out together during cocktail hour or the view from people's tables during dinner or everyone's reactions during the ceremony and speeches. The day truly felt like a blur and we couldn't possibly take it all in at the moment, so this is such a gift to have these pictures.

My only regret is that we didn't book her to stay for the last hour of the reception, and if I could do it again, I would add an extra hour to our package.

We - and our guests - cannot say enough good things about Inna!  Highly recomend booking with Peach Plum Pear Photo!
reviews.author: Amanda Fowler

reviews.text: I can’t even describe how grateful we are to have picked Inna to do our photos for our wedding! She was worth every single penny,  made us feel so relaxed and comfortable, and was super professional! our photos turned out absolutely gorgeous. She did an amazing job personalizing our physical order (see picture!), and making us feel heard and special. Would and already have recommended her wholeheartedly to anyone
reviews.author: Summer Nestorowicz

reviews.text: Inna (Peach Plum Pear Photography) and her team were impeccable! Inna had a handcrafted vision from our engagement pictures to our wedding. Inna planned out all pictures from the time of the sunset to the perfect locations in Philadelphia that would make our photos unique and stand out. She made us feel very comfortable in front of the camera (even though we were very nervous about it). Inna and her team's energy was so positive and we felt that they were genuinely happy to be experiencing our moments with us and that was reflected in the photographs we received for both our engagement and wedding. Being a black couple, it was very important for us to find a photographer that was able to capture the beauty of skin tones in the photography, and Inna and her team were able to do that without a doubt.  Inna (Peach Plum Pear Photography) gets our highest recommendation.
reviews.author: Ebonique Edwards
